label: Reference-inspired equipment starting points · local game items · not a live-patch ranking or win-rate claim.
emblemNote: Equipment order only. Emblems are reference guidance, with no emblem bonuses applied. Choose Flicker and any available roaming blessing separately; Use does not unlock or equip them. Roaming effects remain unavailable in Brawl.

presets.name: Tank / Roam
presets.purpose: Durable pickoff and team utility. Start with mobility, then anti-healing defense and cooldown utility; finish with recovery support, physical protection and a revive. Configure a supported roam blessing separately if desired.

presets.name: Hybrid / Pickoff
presets.purpose: Mix pickoff damage with frontline durability. Two physical attack items support hook follow-ups, while Dominance Ice, Athena's Shield and Immortality provide defensive coverage. Less durable than the tank setup.

presets.name: Damage / Burst
presets.purpose: Aggressive, fragile pickoff alternative inspired by the supplied item order. Physical attack and penetration favor isolated targets; Fleeting Time adds cooldown utility. Not a substitute for the tank build when your team needs a frontline.
